section_summary.extract_value: This section describes a study that developed a Brazilian adaptation of the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) for young adolescents. The study involved 347 adolescents and confirmed the one-factor model of the BAS, showing satisfactory internal consistency and a significant negative correlation (r = -.230) between BAS scores and BMI.
